abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study how political parties engage in political targeting of resources by coordinating politicians across multiple levels of government. We combine thousands of election outcomes from the Indian state of West Bengal with 300 million payments from a welfare scheme jointly controlled by state and local governments. We show that the state government gives disproportionate funding to co-partisan local councils, which target payments to raise votes for national candidates. Welfare payments are diverted to reward local councilors who successfully deliver votes, and to recruit opposition councilors. The ruling party recruits candidates only where it lacks a majority, systematically expanding its control.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政党如何通过协调多级政府中的政治家来实施政治资源定向。我们将印度西孟加拉邦数千个选举结果与一项由邦政府和地方政府共同控制的福利计划中3亿笔支付记录相结合。研究显示，邦政府向同党地方议会提供不成比例的资金，这些资金被用于定向支付以提升国家层面候选人的得票率。福利支付被挪用，用于奖励成功拉票的地方议员，并招募反对党议员。执政党仅在未获得多数席位的地方招募候选人，从而系统性地扩大其控制范围。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
title_zh: 党组织与互补性政治控制

abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>While existing work shows COVID‐19 stay‐at‐home (SAH) policies decreased mobility on average, we lack evidence regarding heterogeneity in policy effectiveness across US counties. To uncover potential heterogeneity, we implement a novel two‐stage approach. First, we employ recent advances in synthetic control estimation and inference to obtain and bound both time‐average and county‐specific treatment effects. Next, we use a local linear forest to explain observed heterogeneity using county‐level predictors. This procedure reveals substantial variation in policy effectiveness and identifies predictors of policy effectiveness which can be used to target future SAH policies.</jats:p>
abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>现有研究表明，新冠疫情居家令政策平均降低了人口流动性，但关于该政策在美国各县间有效性的异质性证据尚不充分。为揭示潜在异质性，我们采用了一种新颖的两阶段方法。首先，利用合成控制估计与推断的最新进展，获取并界定了时间平均效应及县级特定处理效应的边界。其次，通过局部线性森林模型，运用县级预测变量解释观测到的异质性。该流程揭示了政策有效性的显著差异，并识别出可用于未来居家令政策精准施策的预测变量。</jats:p>
title: Deniers and Compliers: Unpacking the Heterogeneous Effectiveness of U.S. Stay‐at‐Home Mandates During the COVID‐19 Pandemic
title_zh: 否认者与遵从者：解析美国COVID-19疫情期间居家令的异质性效果

abstract: In this paper, we study optimal monetary policy in an economy where firms’ price-setting decisions are distorted by a signal-extraction problem: they cannot perfectly distinguish aggregate from idiosyncratic shocks based on noisy local information. This systematic misattribution of aggregate shocks to firm-specific factors generates an additional price response, implying that strict price stability is no longer optimal. Instead, the optimal policy fully stabilizes the output gap, which necessarily requires accommodating fluctuations in the price level. The cyclicality of the optimal price level depends on the source of firms’ incomplete information: learning from local demand signals implies a procyclical price level, whereas learning from local productivity signals yields a countercyclical one.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在价格设定决策中因信号提取问题而扭曲的经济环境下的最优货币政策：企业无法基于含噪的局部信息完美区分总体冲击与异质性冲击。这种将总体冲击系统性误归因于企业特定因素的现象，会引发额外的价格反应，意味着严格的价格稳定不再是最优选择。相反，最优政策应完全稳定产出缺口，这必然要求容忍价格水平的波动。最优价格水平的周期性取决于企业不完全信息的来源：从局部需求信号中学习会导致价格水平呈顺周期性，而从局部生产率信号中学习则会产生逆周期性。
title: Optimal monetary policy with confounding information
title_zh: 混淆信息下的最优货币政策

title_zh: 何时少即是多？在RFQ平台中诱导交易商反应

title_zh: 关于简单偏好与概率加权

title_zh: 气候临界点的不确定性溢价

abstract: Focus We examine how geopolitical risks affect sovereign risk premia for emerging market economies (EMEs). We focus on two measures of sovereign risk: five-year sovereign credit default swap (SCDS) spreads, which show the cost of insuring against a country's default, and JPMorgan Emerging Markets Bond Index (EMBI) spreads, which reflect the extra return investors demand for holding emerging market bonds.
abstract_zh: 焦点 本文考察地缘政治风险如何影响新兴市场经济体的主权风险溢价。我们聚焦于两种主权风险指标：五年期主权信用违约互换（SCDS）利差（反映针对一国违约的保险成本）以及摩根大通新兴市场债券指数（EMBI）利差（体现投资者持有新兴市场债券所要求的额外回报）。
title: Geopolitical risk and emerging market sovereign risk premia
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与新兴市场主权风险溢价

abstract: Sixty-three percent of large companies worldwide had made a net zero commitment by 2023, up from close to none in 2018. But if the target date is 2050, that's several corporate lifetimes away, and the planet needs emission reductions today. What actually changes in the boardroom when a pledge is signed? Simon Dietz (LSE, CEPR) has tracked climate management practices and emissions at nearly 2,000 companies to find out. He tells Tim Phillips that the picture is not the one that either side of the debate might expect. A net zero pledge doesn't usually signify an immediate cut in emissions, but there is a clear and early shift in how companies plan for net zero that has often started before the announcement. What is left is something is harder to spot: firms making a strategic pivot, of which the public commitment is only one part.
abstract_zh: 截至2023年，全球63%的大型企业已做出净零排放承诺，而2018年这一比例几乎为零。但若目标期限设定在2050年，这相当于跨越数个企业生命周期，而地球亟需当下的减排行动。当企业签署承诺书时，董事会层面究竟发生了哪些实质性变化？伦敦政治经济学院及经济政策研究中心的西蒙·迪茨追踪了近2000家企业的气候管理实践与排放数据，试图揭示真相。他向蒂姆·菲利普斯表示，实际情况可能出乎辩论双方的预期。净零承诺通常不会立即带来排放削减，但企业规划净零转型的方式会提前出现明显转变——这种转变往往在公开承诺前就已启动。更难以察觉的是：企业正在实施战略转向，而公开承诺仅是其中一环。
title: Are Net Zero Commitments Greenwash?
title_zh: 净零承诺是漂绿行为吗？

abstract: Fiscal multipliers are larger during natural disasters. Using aggregate and state-level U.S. data, we show that the government-spending multiplier is significantly magnified when natural disasters occur. To rationalize this finding, we develop a New-Keynesian model augmented with disaster risk, in which higher public spending generates a larger output expansion through a strengthened investment channel. Two mechanisms are at work. First, by destroying productive capacity, a disaster raises the marginal productivity of capital, which further crowds in private investment. Second, wealth destruction leads households to draw down less of their savings in response to the fiscal shock, which boosts capital supply.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害期间财政乘数显著增大。基于美国全国及州级数据，我们发现当自然灾害发生时，政府支出乘数会显著放大。为解释这一现象，我们构建了纳入灾害风险的新凯恩斯模型，其中公共支出通过强化投资渠道产生更大的产出扩张效应。两种机制在发挥作用：其一，灾害破坏生产能力后，资本边际生产率提升，进而挤出私人投资；其二，财富损失导致家庭在面临财政冲击时减少储蓄消耗，从而增加资本供给。
authors: Andreas Dibiasi; Céline Poilly; Erica Perego
title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters
title_zh: 自然灾害期间的财政乘数

abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels -- firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业在运营任务和管理任务中同时使用认知技能、人际交往技能和操作技能，不同行业的技能密集度存在差异，且由于企业特有的技术冲击，同一行业内企业规模呈现异质性。基于英国数据校准的模型表明，认知技能是制约生产率的关键因素。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。行业层面约一半的影响源于行业内分布的变化——大型企业相对规模扩大，但生产率反而下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性进一步放大了这些效应。
title: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
title_zh: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率

abstract: ABSTRACT This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。
title: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
title_zh: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响

title: Born in Smog: Immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
title_zh: 雾霾中诞生：1892-1919年伦敦历史急性空气污染暴露的即时与持续健康后果

title: Parameter-invariant unbiased estimation of individual variances and their pairwise products
title_zh: 个体方差及其两两乘积的参数不变无偏估计

abstract: European fascist regimes have attached great importance to nationalistic families and designed policies to perpetuate them. Most offered policy packages with interest-free loans repayable through childbirth, along with allowances and tax deductions for large families. Using a difference-in-difference approach and Nazi Germany as a case study, we show that these policies may have counterproductive effects due to negative selection mechanisms in the marriage market. The excessive pressure to marry exerted on singles results in lower quality, ultimately less fertile, and more fragile unions. This finding is important as the main European far-right parties today propose reinstating these policy packages.
abstract_zh: 欧洲法西斯政权高度重视民族主义家庭，并制定了旨在延续这些家庭的政策。多数政权提供了一揽子政策，包括通过生育偿还的无息贷款，以及对大家庭的补贴和税收减免。本文以纳粹德国为案例，采用双重差分法研究发现，由于婚姻市场中的负向选择机制，这些政策可能产生适得其反的效果。对单身者施加的过度婚姻压力导致婚姻质量下降，最终形成生育率更低、关系更脆弱的结合。这一发现具有重要意义，因为当今欧洲主要极右翼政党正提议重新推行此类政策组合。
title: Pronatalist Policies’ Backlash in Authoritarian Regimes
title_zh: 威权体制下生育鼓励政策的反噬效应

abstract: Europe pays for innovative medicines through 27 uncoordinated national negotiations, generating access delays, cross-country pricing externalities, and a weak position vis-à-vis both pharmaceutical firms and US trade and most-favoured nation pressure. This column argues that Europe should procure innovative on-patent medicines through a single European negotiation that fixes one wholesale price for the entire Single Market, while reintroducing equity across member states through differentiated national contributions and side transfers. Decoupling what the innovator receives from what each country pays would end the pathologies of external reference pricing and parallel trade, restore Europe's bargaining power, and guarantee simultaneous access for all European patients.
abstract_zh: 欧洲通过27个缺乏协调的国家谈判为创新药物买单，导致患者获取药物延迟、跨境定价外部性，以及面对制药公司、美国贸易与最惠国待遇压力时处于弱势地位。本文认为，欧洲应通过单一欧洲谈判采购创新专利药物，为整个单一市场设定统一的批发价格，同时通过差异化的国家缴费和横向转移支付重新实现成员国间的公平。将创新者获得的报酬与各国实际支付金额脱钩，将终结外部参考定价和平行贸易的弊端，恢复欧洲的议价能力，并确保所有欧洲患者能够同步获得药物。
title: Harmonising access and reinventing the procurement of innovative medicines in Europe
title_zh: 协调获取与重塑欧洲创新药物采购

abstract: The EU's fiscal rules in force since 2024 are often criticised for their complexity. The official implementation requires thousands of lines of code and a sophisticated debt sustainability analysis. This column argues that the central result can be approximated by a remarkably simple formula: the required primary balance equals the largest debt-stabilising primary balance in a ten-year period plus roughly 1% of the debt ratio. While this simplification cannot replace the full calculations, it helps demystify the debt rules and provides a shortcut for assessing the impact of policies on debt sustainability.
abstract_zh: 自2024年起生效的欧盟财政规则常因其复杂性而受到批评。官方实施需要数千行代码和复杂的债务可持续性分析。本文认为，其核心结果可通过一个极为简单的公式近似得出：所需的基本财政余额等于十年期内最大的债务稳定基本余额加上约1%的债务比率。尽管这一简化无法替代完整计算，但它有助于揭开债务规则的神秘面纱，并为评估政策对债务可持续性的影响提供了一条捷径。
title: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
title_zh: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱

abstract: We study the effect of commitment on threats in adversarial bargaining—situations in which a proposer (prosecutor) demands payment from a responder (defendant) under the threat of conflict if the demand is rejected. We focus on plea bargaining, where a prosecutor files charges against a defendant before a round of plea bargaining. The charges affect payoffs if an agreement is not reached, and the case proceeds to trial. The expected benefit for the prosecutor at trial is maximized at a lower charge than that which maximizes the defendant’s loss. Just before the trial starts, the prosecutor can reduce the charges up to a certain point depending on their level of commitment power. The experimental data show that participants with sufficient commitment power used it to gain bargaining power by overcharging the defendant. However, they do so more conservatively than the theory predicts.
abstract_zh: 本文研究承诺能力如何影响对抗性谈判中的威胁。在此类情境中，提议方（检察官）向回应方（被告）提出要求，并以要求遭拒后发生冲突作为威胁。本文聚焦辩诉交易：检察官在谈判前先对被告提出指控；若双方未达成协议，案件进入审判，指控将影响双方收益。检察官在审判中的预期收益在较低指控水平达到最大，而使被告损失最大化的指控水平更高。审判开始前，检察官可依据其承诺能力，在一定范围内降低指控。实验数据显示，具备足够承诺能力的参与者会通过提出过高指控来增强谈判能力，但其行为比理论预测更为保守。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Commitment and threats in adversarial bargaining: Insights from a plea bargaining experiment
title_zh: 对抗性谈判中的承诺与威胁：来自辩诉交易实验的启示

title: Migration shocks and voting: Evidence from Ukrainian migration to Poland
title_zh: 移民冲击与投票：来自乌克兰移民至波兰的证据

title: Recursive Preferences and Ambiguity Attitudes
title_zh: 递归偏好与模糊态度
